summary: Wires the orphaned <ImportDialog /> (complete since v0.93 ADR-0041) to the keyboard-accessible `import-asset-btn` trigger added in v0.110.4 (cp5-import-trigger). Adds handleImportDialogImported (dispatches bevy-2d-editor:asset-imported CustomEvent for catalog refresh), handleShowChangeWorkbench (calls window.__setActiveBottomTab('workbench')), and renders the dialog with all 4 required props (isOpen, onClose, onImported, onShowChangeWorkbench). Side-changes: ImportDialog gets data-testid='import-dialog' + tabIndex={-1} for test targeting and a11y focus; BottomDock exposes window.__setActiveBottomTab test bridge (parallels __setEditorMode). New spec (import-dialog.spec.ts) covers S1 happy path + Escape, S2 success + custom event, S3 conflict routing via bridge, S4 error-phase UX. 8/8 new tests pass + 10/10 a11y-critical-paths.spec.ts (no regression). tsc --noEmit clean.
